notice: Synthetic examples using the kit company/icp.example.md and company/persona.example.md rubrics, with current employer identity, business model, company size and role/remit treated as mandatory for this exercise. These are hand-authored expected decisions, not outputs from a model run.

cases.evidence_summary: Example SaaS Ltd: B2B subscription software, 40 employees in Germany, evidenced outbound team. The person is its current Head of Revenue Operations, owns the outbound tooling and pipeline operations.

expected.company_reason: All four company criteria are supported.
expected.persona_reason: Current remit, ownership and tooling responsibilities are supported.
evidence_used: synthetic company evidence: business model, headcount, location, outbound motion
synthetic person evidence: current employer, remit, ownership, tooling

cases.evidence_summary: Example Agency Ltd: a 40-person German services agency with outbound activity. The person owns sales operations there. The example company rubric explicitly excludes agencies.

expected.company_reason: Agency exclusion overrides the supported size, geography and outbound points.
expected.persona_reason: Person fits the operating remit, but that cannot rescue company fit.
evidence_used: synthetic person evidence: current employer and sales-operations remit

cases.evidence_summary: Example Software Ltd: B2B subscription software in Germany with outbound activity, but no supported employee count. Current Head of Revenue Operations with evidenced tooling responsibility.

expected.company_reason: Headcount is mandatory in this exercise; its absence holds the decision despite a high partial score.
expected.persona_reason: Current remit and ownership are supported.
evidence_used: synthetic company evidence: business model, geography, outbound motion
synthetic person evidence: role and current employer

cases.evidence_summary: Example SaaS Ltd passes all company criteria. The profile explicitly says the person left the company last year and now has an unrelated role.

expected.persona_reason: Former employee; current responsibilities do not match the target employer.
evidence_used: synthetic company evidence: all company criteria
synthetic person evidence: ended employment and unrelated current role
